title: Base Batches 005
description: Base's program for early-stage teams building on Base: an 8-week virtual program with a dedicated advisor, weekly support and a Demo Day pitch to VCs. Selected teams in Batch 004 received a $100K investment from the Base Ecosystem Fund. Batch 005 is not announced yet.
reward: $100K investment from the Base Ecosystem Fund (Batch 004)
opens_note: Batch 005 is not announced yet. Base Batches runs twice a year.

eligibility.note: a team committed to Base as its default implementation and network of choice, with no formal Seed round raised

rules: Batch 004 (applications Aug 19 to Sep 10, program Sep 29 to Nov 15, Demo Day Nov 17 in New York) is closed; Batch 005 is not announced yet. The program runs twice a year.
Early stage: pre-product to post-MVP teams that have not yet raised a formal Seed round.
Base first: teams committed to Base as their default implementation and network of choice.
Focus areas: trading, payments, agents, financing, and asset issuance.
